documents.title: Certificate under SEBI (Depositories and Participants) Regulations, 2018

analysis.summary: Srivari Spices and Foods Limited reported robust H1 FY26 financial performance with revenue of Rs. 78.77 crores, EBITDA of Rs. 13.43 crores, and PAT of Rs. 7.20 crores. Management highlighted expansions in distribution channels, onboarding on major e-commerce platforms like DMart online and Big Basket, and new product initiatives including Soya Chunks and a planned vertical for puja articles.

guidance.claim: Management stated that H2 will be better than H1.
guidance.quote: So, that will be picked up very well. So, H2 will be better than H1.

guidance.claim: The management expects FY27 to be the best in their past complete history.
guidance.quote: As I said, new products are launched, so might be 100% will achieve. Exactly, I can't comment on that. But it will be better than, FY '27 will be the best in our past complete history.

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted that the demand environment continues to be encouraging.
demand_outlook.quote: The demand environment continues to be encouraging and we are confident of sustaining the growth momentum in the second half.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated they are getting a very good response from the market for groundnut oil.
demand_outlook.quote: But we are having very good response from the market.

demand_outlook.claim: The Indian soy protein market is projected to grow at a CAGR of approximately 6% from 2024 to 2029.
demand_outlook.quote: The Indian soy protein market is projected to grow at a CAGR of ~6% from 2024 –2029, driven by rising health awareness and higher protein consumption.

demand_outlook.claim: Over 70% of Indians do not consume the recommended daily protein intake.
demand_outlook.quote: Over 70% of Indians do not consume the recommended daily protein intake (Source: Indian Market Research Bureau).

demand_outlook.claim: Management noted that the market size for spices is over INR2 lakhs crores, with 70% currently belonging to unorganized trade.
demand_outlook.quote: As I said, one important thing is in the spices, still 70% is an unorganized trade.

demand_outlook.claim: The company stated that about 70% of atta is in loose unorganized form.
demand_outlook.quote: As well as atta is also same, 70% is in the loose atta which is unorganized.

capex_expansion.claim: The company is planning to introduce a new business vertical focused on puja articles, devotional goods, festival related items and allied products.
capex_expansion.quote: Looking ahead, we are planning to introduce a new business vertical focused on manufacturing, trading and distribution of puja articles, devotional goods, festival related items and allied products.

capex_expansion.claim: Management is planning for a plant for Soya Chunks after two quarters.
capex_expansion.quote: After one shield kit, just standard shields, we will go for the plant. Install the capacity later, after 2 quarters.

capex_expansion.claim: The company launched a new oil plant and officially introduced its products in Mumbai on 28 July 2025.
capex_expansion.quote: Launched a new oil plant and officially introduced its products in Mumbai, Maharashtra on 28 July 2025 .

capex_expansion.claim: Management stated that the oil plant has an installed capacity of 7,200 tons per annum.
capex_expansion.quote: Regarding oil, we have installed capacity of 7,200 tons per annum but this plant is yet to be commercialized.

margins_costs.claim: H1 FY26 EBITDA margin stood at 17.05% and PAT margin at 9.14%.
margins_costs.quote: Our profitability remained healthy with EBITDA margin of 17.05% and PAT margin of 9.14%.

margins_costs.claim: Management stated that the oil division is currently at EBITDA breakeven.
margins_costs.quote: No, exactly breakeven only, not in the losses.

margins_costs.claim: Management stated that gross profit is positive around INR0.12.
margins_costs.quote: Our gross profit are positive in around INR0.12.

orders_capacity.claim: Installed capacity for Spices is 3,600 tons with a utilization of 2,637 tons.
orders_capacity.quote: For Spices, we have an installed capacity of 3,600 tons and we have utilized 2,637 tons.

orders_capacity.claim: Installed capacity for Atta is 14,400 tons with a utilization of 12,650 tons.
orders_capacity.quote: And when it comes to Atta, installed capacity is 14,400 tons and we have utilized 12,650 tons.

orders_capacity.claim: For spices and masalas, the installed capacity is 3,600 tons per annum with current utilization at about 2,637 tons.
orders_capacity.quote: For spices and masalas, we have an installed capacity of 3,600 tons per annum with the current utilization at about 2,637 tons.

orders_capacity.claim: For atta, the installed capacity is 14,400 tons per annum with 12,650 tons utilized.
orders_capacity.quote: When it comes to atta, 14,400 tons per annum installed capacity and we have utilized 12,650 tons.

capital_allocation.claim: Management stated they will go for bank debt if needed for expansion.
capital_allocation.quote: We will be going for the debt as of now. If we need exactly, we will go for the debts of the bankers.

capital_allocation.claim: Rights shares were issued on 10th October 2024 to enhance the capital structure.
capital_allocation.quote: Rights Shares issued on 10th Oct, 2024 to enhance capital structure.

capital_allocation.claim: The company utilized the entire rights issue amount for specified objects without any deviation.
capital_allocation.quote: So, as disclosed in the letter of offer, we have utilized the entire amount for the specified purpose without any deviation.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management noted that geographical expansion outside the home state can be tough and take time for proper placement.
risks_headwinds.quote: Because when we go for the placement of the new product in a new region, it will be quite tough. It will take at least a year to get the proper placement also.

management_commitments.claim: Management plans to launch new Pooja products around January.
management_commitments.quote: In Jan, roughly in the Jan, we are going to launch.

management_commitments.claim: Management plans to reach up to 30% oil capacity utilization in H2.
management_commitments.quote: Now, we can utilize up to 30% in this H2.

management_commitments.claim: Management plans to consider export market expansion in FY27.
management_commitments.quote: Next year, we will plan for the expansion. Next year, we are into the planning for that.

management_commitments.claim: Management stated that all oil products will be placed in complete marketplaces by the end of the month.
management_commitments.quote: All the oil product will be placed in the complete marketplaces.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
